subject: general
question: Seven people, D, E, F, G, L, M and N, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only M sits to the left of N. Only four people sit between M and L. Only F sits between G and D, and G is not an immediate neighbour of L. Who sits at the extreme right of the line?
solution: Given: Seven people, D, E, F, G, L, M and N, are sitting in a row, facing north. 1) Only M sits to the left of N. 2) Only four people sit between M and L.
